name: Securitize Tokenized AAA CLO Fund
oneLiner: STAC is a Securitize-issued tokenized AAA CLO private fund (BVI), custodied at BNY and sub-advised by BNY Investments; NAV-accreting Rule 506(c) share.
collateral: Tokenized fund shares in Securitize AAA CLO Tokenized Fund, Ltd., a BVI private fund investing substantially all assets in U.S. dollar-denominated AAA-rated CLO tranches, with BNY as custodian and BNY Investments as sub-advisor.
pegMechanism: NAV-accreting tokenized private-fund share rather than a fixed $1 peg; eligible investors subscribe through Securitize with Ethereum-issued shares, KYC/AML and investor-qualification controls, and limited liquidity/no guaranteed secondary market.

jurisdiction.license: BVI Business Company; Rule 506(c) private placement; Investment Company Act Section 3(c)(1) exemption

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: STAC is issued through permissioned fund or issuer rails with KYC-gated primary-market access and issuer/admin controls over transfer, mint, redemption, or token administration.

mintAuthority.summary: STAC's reviewed Ethereum Securitize DSToken surface exposes issueTokens functions and the Ethereum owner resolves to an EOA; additional DSApp or on-ramp mint routes were not ruled out.

controls.label: STAC Securitize DSToken issuance surface
controls.evidence: Ethereum lane reads returned implementation 0x77684815f44b28726bc3efa4471b88ef3b93feb0 and owner() = 0x59c1eAcEc450c57Dcb9b8725d0F96635C2b676Ee. Partial Sourcify DSToken source exposes issueTokens, issueTokensCustom, and issueTokensWithMultipleLocks issuance functions.

controls.label: STAC token owner
controls.evidence: Lane code read returned no contract bytecode for this owner, so no on-chain multisig threshold or Safe policy was verified.

review.evidence: Securitize materials and Ethereum DSToken source/direct reads identify an issuer-operated issueTokens path and EOA owner for the reviewed Ethereum deployment.
unresolvedQuestions: Verify whether any additional DSApp or on-ramp mint route should be represented separately.
